adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/adapters/rest.js.es6`, `basePath` was changed to check `ADMIN_MODELS.indexOf(type.replace('_', '-')) !== -1`. JS `String#replace` without a global regex replaces only the first underscore, so any future/admin model type containing multiple underscores would not be normalized correctly and could fail to route under `/admin/`. In this diff, the listed admin types (`plugin`, `site-customization`, `embeddable-host`) correspond to types with 0–1 underscores (`plugin`, `site_customization`, `embeddable_host`), so it likely works now, but the edge-case is real and untested. The diff’s JS tests cover store embedding changes, not adapter `basePath` behavior for `embeddable_host`.
